method.methodLabel: Literal minimum published decision-row ICR floor
method.rationale: Selected default: promote the literal 125% lender floor because it is the cleanest semantic match to the model's hard underwriting rule.

excludedRows.notes: On-disk file appears to be a 30 May 2022 CHL Mortgages guide rather than a 2024 CMI artifact so it is excluded from the proxy decision.

rejectedCandidates.methodLabel: Map 125% at the retained representative stress rate onto BANK_INITIAL_RATE
rejectedCandidates.rationale: Rejected: this adds a rate-translation layer and makes the result depend on a diagnostic stress-rate choice rather than the published ratio.

rejectedCandidates.methodLabel: Mean of retained cross-segment decision-row ICR thresholds
rejectedCandidates.rationale: Rejected: equal-weighting visible segments invents a market mix and would likely over-tighten the representative bank.
